brief: Asserts that value is dataType rfc822Name
description: Returns value unchanged if it is dataType rfc822Name. Otherwise, including when value is undefined, throws an error. It never converts: to get a rfc822Name from a value of another data type, write a typed literal or call a to_ function. This is usually written value as rfc822Name.

errorsThrown.reason: value is not the asserted data type
